title: Bound fixed Type A J8/J9 write axes after QUERY demotion
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

At port 0 of the retimed Type A caller, demoting QUERYs 1580 and 1659 and retiring the productive phases on roots 0 and 18 cannot work with the original J8/J9 write axes and fixed middle transport. At the legal phase $q=i$ with unit bodies, the retained exterior span has rank four and the required columns raise it to six. The two row differences $1-10$ and $19-28$ annihilate the retained span and give $\operatorname{diag}(2-2i,2-2i)$ on input columns 0 and 18, with determinant $-8i$. This applies even with arbitrary additional reads and clean side state. A single new write direction or rank-one middle change alone still falls short.

At $q=-1$, two inputs invisible to the forced J8 gather and original J9 inputs require independent J9 responses with determinant $-8$. One extra read at J8 and two at J9 reproduce all 36 columns at that specialization when the reads are independently granted. The exterior ranks 3 and 2 also force a lost port-state direction at J8. There is no physical adapter or changed paid profile. Verified κ change is zero.

## Task and overlap

Changed scope of `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 8 on canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact sources are #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`, #7334 `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, #7404 `1ec899dade2febbfb155f0ca015b9cc0356bd7e2` and #7412 `4dfa0a393fd12101af5ffed161ed1bc5aa045f11`. #7412 fixes the input axes too. This contribution grants additional inputs and supplies the separate imaginary-phase write obstruction. #7417 changes the late-mask target at cut 1741. #7420 regroups literal phase legs in the unretired caller. Neither is this ingress experiment. The branch carries the two existing #7257 CI prerequisites. [Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19564357).

## Verification

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-a-two-host-exterior-bound/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-type-a-two-host-exterior-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-type-a-two-host-exterior-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

The replay checks 36 columns across four phases and three body assignments, cross-checks the decisive imaginary-phase columns with an independent Gaussian-rational walk, and checks both real-sign probes and the enlarged control. Registered, committed-byte and Git-free export checks passed on CPython 3.12.3. An altered caller and an incorrect right-arm aggregate both fail their controls.

## Credit

Rohan Arun supplied the signed caller. Clear1nsight supplied the native comparator and retiming. ToikY supplied #7412's witnesses and price and #7342's Laurent evaluator. ChatGPT Pro found the timed two-probe obstruction and enlarged real-sign control. OpenAI Codex independently replayed them and established the imaginary-phase and lost-state rank bounds.

## Open next questions

Test one literal changed transport or egress that supplies both imaginary-phase quotient directions. Start with the two row differences on columns 0 and 18, then require all phases, all-body action, dirty restoration and the full invoice. #7412's optimistic complete margin remains below 0.042700441873467 raw at one port before added work.
